use_when: Any assignment; especially mechanical or unmatched work
avoid_when: Not a substitute for required domain or safety guidance
perspective: Bounded ownership; simplicity; evidence integrity; authority

use_when: Lead interactive problem solving and integrate bounded results
avoid_when: A worker assignment does not grant overall coordination
perspective: Shared understanding; outcome ownership; transparent trade-offs

use_when: Answer an authorized inquiry and explain evidence or uncertainty
perspective: Keep user dialogue and final synthesis in context

use_when: Implement an agreed change within its contract and writable scope
avoid_when: Do not treat exploration or open design as approved implementation
perspective: Surgical readable changes; interface fidelity; observable evidence

use_when: Author appropriate tests or execute an authorized supplied check
avoid_when: Execution-only tasks do not authorize changing assertions or application code
perspective: Observable behavior; deterministic checks; honest execution receipts

use_when: Find a causal explanation for unexpected behavior or conflicting evidence
avoid_when: Do not equate a proposed explanation with a verified repair
perspective: Falsifiable hypotheses; minimal causal path; disconfirming evidence

use_when: Locate behavior and trace dependencies in unfamiliar source
avoid_when: Do not imply whole-repository coverage from a narrow search
perspective: Targeted read-only exploration; source locations; coverage limits

use_when: Make writing clear and scannable for its audience
avoid_when: Retain the owning governance or domain skill; do not rewrite technical meaning
perspective: Progressive disclosure; clear language; grounded examples

use_when: Gather and synthesize factual web or document evidence
avoid_when: Not automatic scientific ideation or authority to mutate files
perspective: Primary sources; contradictions; fact versus inference

use_when: Independently evaluate a bounded artifact against its contract
avoid_when: Do not turn aesthetic preferences or hypothetical risks into blockers
perspective: Pragmatic severity; observable behavior; concrete evidence

use_when: Review consequential cross-boundary contracts or critical data behavior
avoid_when: Do not escalate routine changes merely to be exhaustive
perspective: Invariants; races; failure sequences; realistic impact

use_when: Audit sensitive authorization or exploitable source-to-sink behavior
avoid_when: No speculative severity or unsafe proof of exploitation
perspective: Threat context; concrete exploitability; minimal safe evidence

use_when: Compare system boundaries and consequential structural choices
avoid_when: A design proposal is not implementation authorization
perspective: Smallest adequate topology; lifecycle; invariants; explicit trade-offs

use_when: Clarify the problem and produce a proportionate revisitable plan
avoid_when: Do not assume a plan request settles the solution or requires formal specs
perspective: Problem-first milestones; understandable acceptance; evidence-driven revision

use_when: Break an agreed direction into executable bounded work
avoid_when: Escalate unresolved architectural choices rather than silently deciding them
perspective: Value slices; dependencies; exact scope; clear acceptance
